kernel_tail_run.label: same recipe, alternative reward shape
kernel_tail_run.note: No measurable difference at full scale (one training run each).

hardware_note: Our runs were scored on an RTX 6000 Ada and SONIC's on an RTX 5000 Ada; we did not measure whether the GPU model changes the counts.

lafan1.note: Tracking is closer in both seeds, and the failure count is in SONIC's range. Over whole clips the policy drifts in world position (its goal has no root-position term), so a single slip over minutes fails a clip; the segments measure tracking itself.
lafan1.hardware_note: Scored on an RTX 4090 (seed 0, SONIC) and an RTX 6000 Ada (seed 1).

not_measurable.title: World-model coordinate frame
not_measurable.text: The heading frame we inherited is singular when the pelvis points straight up or down, mid-flip; we use body-frame features instead. A full run with the heading frame reaches the same result (9 / 11 / 8 failures at 80k / 84k / 86k, tracking score 0.9540), within the spread between seeds: at this scale, the flips were decided by the sampling fix above.

not_measurable.title: A different shape for the tracking reward
not_measurable.text: A linear tail added to the reward's Gaussian shape: 11 failures, tracking score 0.9528, against the released recipe's 10 and 0.9545. The released model uses the paper's shape.
